<Project Sdk="Aspire.AppHost.Sdk/13.6.5">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <AspireUseCliBundle>false</AspireUseCliBundle>
    <OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <IsPublishable>true</IsPublishable>
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);ASPIRE010</NoWarn>
    <UserSecretsId>hexalith-eventstore</UserSecretsId>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(HexalithTenantsFromSource)' == 'true'">
    <DefineConstants>$(DefineConstants);HEXALITH_TENANTS_SOURCE</DefineConstants>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Server.Host\Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.Server.Host.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.UI\Hexalith.EventStore.Admin.UI.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore\Hexalith.EventStore.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\samples\Hexalith.EventStore.Sample\Hexalith.EventStore.Sample.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\samples\Hexalith.EventStore.Sample.BlazorUI\Hexalith.EventStore.Sample.BlazorUI.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\samples\Hexalith.EventStore.Sample.Api\Hexalith.EventStore.Sample.Api.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\..\tests\Hexalith.EventStore.TestSubscriber\Hexalith.EventStore.TestSubscriber.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Aspire\Hexalith.EventStore.Aspire.csproj" IsAspireProjectResource="false" />
    <ProjectReference Include="$(HexalithTenantsBasePath)\Hexalith.Tenants\Hexalith.Tenants.csproj" Condition="'$(HexalithTenantsFromSource)' == 'true'" />
    <ProjectReference Include="$(HexalithTenantsBasePath)\Hexalith.Tenants.Api\Hexalith.Tenants.Api.csproj" Condition="'$(HexalithTenantsFromSource)' == 'true'" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Aspire.Hosting.Azure.AppContainers" />
    <PackageReference Include="Aspire.Hosting.Docker" />
    <PackageReference Include="Aspire.Hosting.Kubernetes" />
    <PackageReference Include="CommunityToolkit.Aspire.Hosting.Dapr" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Content Include="DaprComponents/**/*">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </Content>
    <Content Include="KeycloakRealms/**/*">
      <CopyToOutputDirectory>PreserveNewest</CopyToOutputDirectory>
    </Content>

  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

Hexalith.EventStore.Aspire.text:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <Description>.NET Aspire hosting extensions for the Hexalith event store — DAPR topology orchestration for distributed event sourcing development</Description>
    <!-- NU5104: this package depends on preview Aspire integrations (DAPR-on-Aspire and Keycloak).
         There are no stable versions to pin to, so a stable release of this package necessarily carries
         those prerelease dependencies. Suppress NU5104 here only (not globally). -->
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);NU5104</NoWarn>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts\Hexalith.EventStore.Contracts.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Client\Hexalith.EventStore.Client.csproj" />
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.ServiceDefaults\Hexalith.EventStore.ServiceDefaults.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Aspire.Hosting" />
    <PackageReference Include="Aspire.Hosting.Keycloak" />
    <PackageReference Include="Aspire.Hosting.Redis" />
    <PackageReference Include="CommunityToolkit.Aspire.Hosting.Dapr" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="../../tools/Hexalith.EventStore.RuntimeIdentityProbe/Hexalith.EventStore.RuntimeIdentityProbe.csproj"
                      ReferenceOutputAssembly="false" OutputItemType="EmbeddedResource" PrivateAssets="all" />
  </ItemGroup>
  <Target Name="NameSelectedOwnerRuntimeIdentityProbe" BeforeTargets="CreateManifestResourceNames" DependsOnTargets="ResolveProjectReferences">
    <ItemGroup>
      <EmbeddedResource Update="@(EmbeddedResource)" Condition="'%(Filename)' == 'Hexalith.EventStore.RuntimeIdentityProbe' and '%(Extension)' == '.dll'">
        <LogicalName>Hexalith.EventStore.Aspire.RuntimeIdentityProbe.dll</LogicalName>
      </EmbeddedResource>
    </ItemGroup>
  </Target>

  <ItemGroup>
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Hexalith.EventStore.AppHost.Tests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Hexalith.EventStore.Server.LiveSidecar.Tests" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <IsPublishable>true</IsPublishable>
    <GenerateDocumentationFile>true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);CS1591</NoWarn>
    <EnableContainer>true</EnableContainer>
    <ContainerRepository>eventstore</ContainerRepository>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="Authentication\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Authorization\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Commands\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Configuration\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Controllers\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="ErrorHandling\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Extensions\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Filters\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="HealthChecks\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Indexes\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Middleware\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Models\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="OpenApi\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Pipeline\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Queries\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Services\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="SignalRHub\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Telemetry\**\*.cs" />
    <Compile Remove="Validation\**\*.cs" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Gateway\Hexalith.EventStore.Gateway.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug' and '$(EnablePrivateCatalogInvocationProof)' == 'true'">
    <DefineConstants>$(DefineConstants);PRIVATE_CATALOG_INVOCATION_PROOF</DefineConstants>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Debug' and '$(EnablePrivateCatalogInvocationProof)' == 'true'">
    <ProjectReference Include="..\Hexalith.EventStore.Testing\Hexalith.EventStore.Testing.csproj" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Dapr.AspNetCore" />
    <PackageReference Include="MediatR" />
    <PackageReference Include="FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis" />
    <PackageReference Include="Swashbuckle.AspNetCore.SwaggerUI" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
